answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops fakes. A newcomer stakes 40 POA for 20 epochs, posts a signed sonnet and names its referrer; all referrals are public, so a star cluster round one referrer traces a ridge line. Peers may dispute an identity: if fake, its escrow is slashed and its referrer loses half too. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 × 40 = 40,000 POA, versus a few hundred POA an epoch. A lone sparrow pays once, keeps its reward.
